title: DreamMusicForge Assembly Package
description: Stage 9: post-generation assembly. Two problems that no single provider call solves: (1) any shot where a character sings on camera must come from a provider that generates video, vocal audio, and lip sync together in one call -- not silent video plus a separate bolt-on lip-sync pass, which has more failure points and more audio/video drift; native_av_policy makes that a checked requirement, not just a design note. (2) generated clip length is never exactly the planned cut duration, so every cut needs a reconciliation strategy (speed_adjust / trim / pad_hold_last_frame) derived deterministically from the drift and whether the cut is beat-matched, or is explicitly routed to requires_manual_review rather than silently forced to fit. concat_command is a real, re-derivable ffmpeg command built from the reconciliation results, not hand-written.

native_av_policy.description: Every shot with a singing, lip-synced performer must use a provider capable of generating video, vocal audio, and lip sync in one call. Checked by validate_native_av_requirement() against the paired Provider-Specific Production Package's video_prompts[].provider.

allowed_providers.description: Documented candidates as of this writing: kling_ai_avatar, runway_act_two, veo3_native_audio. Extend as new native audio-driven providers emerge -- this is a curated allowlist, not a locked enum.

shot_assemblies.description: One entry per cut in the paired Editorial Architecture's edit_timeline. Every cut_id must be covered (checked by validate_against_editorial_architecture).

actual_duration_seconds.description: In a worked example with no live generation, this is a simulated/illustrative figure, not a real provider result -- see non_goals.

reconciled_duration_seconds.description: Must be null when reconciliation_strategy is requires_manual_review, and equal to planned_duration_seconds otherwise -- reconciliation always targets the planned timeline, it never silently redefines it.

ffmpeg_filter.description: Null when reconciliation_strategy is exact_match or requires_manual_review.

audio_mix_plan.description: One entry per cut. Score volume ducks under cuts where a performer sings so the vocal stays intelligible.

assembly_status.description: blocked_manual_review_required whenever any shot_assemblies entry has reconciliation_strategy requires_manual_review -- checked for reproducibility, not just asserted.

concat_command.description: An ffmpeg filter_complex command built deterministically from shot_assemblies -- re-derivable, checked the same way generation_risk_estimate is in the Provider-Specific Production Package.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.
